meta.report: WA — FINAL cluster allocation of previously-unallocated strongs
meta.author: le Roux Cilliers

decisions.F2: T2 for strongs not denoting inner being
decisions.F3: schema incl. cluster_code, confidence, operation, alt_clusters, review_flag, rationale
decisions.F4: FLAG reserved (IB but no cluster); never auto-assigned from cluster.csv gloss list
decisions.T3: new cluster 'Operations' — human operations not tied to one cluster, or undetermined; context pairs at verse level
decisions.edge_rule: direct meaning-relation to a cluster → that cluster (not T3); T3 only when undetermined or applies-to-many; edge (T3+one cluster) rare
decisions.medium: accepted as suggested (likely bucket, not final meaning)
decisions.descriptors: left in T2 (T2=supplementary); only directly-cluster-tied descriptors pulled; no separate T4 bucket

method: Precedent-grounded: prior 2801 labelled allocations + cluster.csv gloss/translit lists as precedent (P1 labelled / P2 gloss / P3 translit).
HIGH = single-cluster gloss precedent. MEDIUM = precedent-conflict / profile suggestion / T2-hint (accepted). LOW = semantic pass (operation→cluster-or-T3; non-op→IB-cluster-or-T2).
Operations carve-out to T3; generic ops in IB clusters → T3; nasa 'to lift' mis-pool reclustered.
Profile scores were decision-support only; counts inform, never decide.
meta.caveat: Evidence is gloss+transliteration+count only (no verse layer). Buckets are provisional homes for verse-level analysis, not final meaning. review_flag=true items and all low/descriptor items are the primary review set.
